checks: Compared the complete revised statement and proof to the original bytes. The sharp-product construction, exact budget and hinge, normal stress and eigenvector argument are unchanged.

The general compatibility hypothesis now requires zero actual cap mass on every other fiber. The hinge integrand is zero outside the cap, so all other-fiber cap and hinge moments vanish. The hypothesis separately eliminates multiplied section moments there, which could persist even when cap mass is zero.

The own section has centroid g with constant coarea density. All nonzero contact moments have the same continuous point g, so subtracting g times the mass balance cancels the own section and contact terms. After dividing by positive alpha_0 the equality is c w_i/(d+1)=Psi_i Sigma u_i.

Substituting the normalized own cap normal and hinge-to-mass ratio gives exactly the stated compatibility equation. The transformed barycentric gradients span and have pairwise nonzero inner products, so simultaneous compatibility is equivalent to a single positive eigenvalue of the symmetric relative covariance operator.

The sharp-budget product already forces zero off-fiber actual cap mass and the explicitly isolated normal stress has zero budget multipliers. The broader original source statement without off-fiber mass exclusion is not asserted in the revised result.

issues.defect: Own-centroid contacts and vanishing multiplied other-fiber section moments do not imply zero other-fiber cap mass. Eliminating the mass balance leaves α_0 times the sum of off-fiber actual cap displacement moments, and Ψ_i still contains off-fiber hinge. For example, take the standard own triangle at base zero, and at the four bases ±e_1,±e_2 take the triangle x≥1/3, y≥1/3, x+y≤1. Use margin x−1/3, normalization I, α_0=1 and r_i=0. Its own cap y-displacement moment is −2/81, canceled by four off-fiber moments of 1/162 each. The cap base moment is zero and the x-displacement moment equals Ψ_i, so the cap-level moment balances with contact at the own centroid hold, but the claimed local equation has a nonzero own y-displacement. All listed fibers are realized by their lifted hull because the four outer triangles lie in the own triangle.
